events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his showmanship, his incredible legacy – still giving us all the feels, decades on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal moment in music history, still sounding fresh as ever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have been 87 this year.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since we lost a true icon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of the Starman today. David Bowie would have turned 80. An innovator, an artist, a true legend. Forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves and our hearts.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page Power
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, a true guitar god.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! Still got that unmistakable voice and swagger.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Main Man
angles.copy: One Step Beyond to 66! Happy Birthday to the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs from Madness. Still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Young at 71
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the voice behind some of the 80s' smoothest tracks, Paul Young! Hope it's a good one.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music superstar Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! An icon, a songwriter, and a national treasure. Here's to more joy and glitter.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Barlow's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still 'Back for Good' on the music scene.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Ocean's Birthday
angles.copy: Get out of our dreams and into our feed for Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! Wishing a fantastic day to the 'Caribbean Queen' singer.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame First Induction Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held in New York City.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: 31 years ago, rock history was made! The very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place. Who were your favourite inaugural inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! Still charming us with his unique style, from Take That to his solo ventures.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockout
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The ultimate impromptu gig!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer and drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil's Day
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! An incredible career with Genesis and as a solo artist. What's your top track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Grant's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the undeniably charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to more recent darker roles, he's always a highlight.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the Prince of Pop, Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo dominance, he's still bringing the moves and the hits.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true British icon, still making us laugh and keeping us entertained.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. 68 years since we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s smash hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Rollin' to 61
angles.copy: Never gonna give him up! Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Rick Astley. Still got those moves and that voice!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Marley Magic Tribute
angles.copy: One Love, One Heart. Remembering the iconic Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of peace and unity resonates always.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole's Compositions
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! A true songwriting genius whose music has shaped generations.

events.title: Whitney Houston's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of 'The Voice', Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years. Still no one quite like Whitney. Remembering 'The Voice' today and her incredible, unmatched talent.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop sensations Take That announced their split, breaking millions of hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Heartbreak
angles.copy: Remember where you were when Take That announced their split 31 years ago today? A moment that truly broke the hearts of a generation. Good job they got back together, eh?

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40's lead singer Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: UB40's Ali
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Ali Campbell, the unmistakable voice of UB40! Hope you're having a 'Red Red Wine' kind of day.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, he continues to write the soundtrack to our lives.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George's Day Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of the 'Quiet Beatle' today. George Harrison would have been 84. His songwriting and spiritual journey left an indelible mark.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who's legendary frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Daltrey's Day
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to The Who's iconic frontman, Roger Daltrey! Still smashing it, just like his microphone.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: 80s pop star and songwriter Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Kershaw's Kicks
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good to be 69? Happy Birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw, bringing us those classic 80s vibes!

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Martin's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin! Half a century of hits, from Exeter to global stadiums. What's your favourite Coldplay track?

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Rock legend Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Bon Jovi's Birthday
angles.copy: Whoa, we're halfway there! Happy 65th Birthday to the one and only Jon Bon Jovi. Still rocking us with those anthems.
